options.text: The $S-S-S$ bond angles in the $S_{8}$ and $S_{6}$ rings are the same.
Rhombic and monoclinic sulphur have $\mathrm{S}_{8}$ molecules.

solution.text: The $\mathrm{S}_{6}$ molecule has a chair-form hexagon ring with the approx same bond length as that in $\mathrm{S}_{8}$, but with some what smaller bond angles i.e. bond lengths are approx same but bond angles are different.
